anhydrite-v1: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent environmental sprite for BrineSpace, an underwater station game. Strict orthographic overhead camera looking straight DOWN, natural asymmetric silhouette; matte hand-painted illustrated texture, restrained small granular brush detail readable at 100 physical pixels, coherent with subdued grey rock and olive root seabed art. Gentle diffuse top light, no dramatic cast shadow, no glossy 3D rendering, no thick comic outlines, no cartoon, no isometric view, no typography, no border, no surrounding scene, no blue underwater grading (engine provides it). True transparent background with clean alpha and transparent spaces; entire subject inside frame with generous margin. Subject: ONE compact low hydrothermal anhydrite deposit viewed from above, three irregular broken chalk-grey mineral collars embedded in dark basalt. Small hollow dark mouths visible from overhead; irregular chipped pale grey crust with sparse muted sulphur-ochre stains. Shallow rough crust rims rather than tall tube chimneys. A few tiny basalt fragments hugging the base. No coral, no plant, no gold jewelry, no bright yellow beads. Overall footprint slightly wider than tall.
